original_prompt:
As an expert project manager and CTO, orchestrate a review and improvement of the SULCUS portal. 
1. Sign-in/Registration: Ensure a clear, functional flow for users.
2. 'Enter Agent Identifier': Add clear instructions/labels explaining its purpose (identifying your agent fleet) and validate its behavior.
3. GitHub Links: Verify and correct all GitHub links to 'https://github.com/digitalforgeca/sulcus' (public) and 'https://github.com/digitalforgeca/sulcus-enterprise' (private). Remove any references to 'digitalforgeca'.
4. Validation: Use a final Claude CLI invocation to review and confirm all tasks are complete.
